bluf: Delante is a founder led Kraków SEO, SEM and AI search agency, founded in 2014, with 65+ specialists by its homepage. It sells international and ecommerce SEO, Google Ads and AI search optimisation (AISO) as three lead lines and moved into ChatGPT Ads when the channel opened in Poland on 24 August 2026. The Horus read is Neutral (+7): best placed for KJ1, most exposed to KJ6. A rival should know it sells paid social with no social ad pixel on its own site, its 4556 URL sitemap shows 4 updates in 90 days, and displacement 60.1 on the Monsoon read says its mixed book buys on price.
doing:
The positioning line, a hands on SEO, SEM and AI search agency for international and ecommerce sites turning visibility and traffic into predictable revenue, decodes as: it does the search work itself, for sites selling across borders, priced on revenue rather than rankings. The headline claim, an award winning team of 65+ specialists serving international leaders in 35 markets, is a claim; the case page lists about 40 studies. Owners named: Matt (Mateusz) Calik, CEO, and Jacek Blaut, Managing Partner.

The sold mix runs 12 lines: international SEO, SEO for ecommerce, local SEO, AI visibility monitoring, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Allegro Ads, ChatGPT Ads, content, e-PR, analytics and UX, and link building. Three lead lines score 3: AI Search / GEO (AI Audit and Visibility Monitoring services; Kiwi.com AI share of voice 25% to 62%), Paid Search (cases include 1,057% ROAS bid optimisation and PMax) and SEO (80% of staff are SEOs). Three core lines score 2: Content & Digital PR (the LongLife case built brand authority through ePR), Paid Social (Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn and Pinterest Ads; a Meta Ads case lifted ecommerce revenue 115%) and Retail Media (an Allegro Ads case grew sales value 84% in three months). Proprietary items listed: AI Authority Link Building and the Delante Shopping Platform (CSS). The record lists no partners.

AI posture in plain terms: AISO is a core line sold as audits, monitoring, AI Authority Link Building and training; the one dated move (2026-08) is that it began managing ChatGPT Ads campaigns as the channel opened in Poland on 24 August 2026. Pricing signals: the Polish services index links an SEO pricing page (Pozycjonowanie cennik), figures not captured; it offers a free GA4 audit and a competitor link building spend estimate. Conspicuously absent for an agency of its kind: no news, jobs or case study text in the deep record, no owned audience or CRM line, and no partner badges.
clients:
Delante serves a mixed book in ecommerce, travel and tourism, fashion, home and interiors, medical and aesthetic medicine, sport and outdoor, industrial and manufacturing, logistics, automotive and finance, from Kraków, Poland, its only listed office.

The record holds 22 clients, 12 with an observed need and 10 names only. The mix reads organic demand first (N1, share 0.522), then AI and automation (N9, 0.247), with brand, paid, web, commerce and local at 0.072 or below. The signals: vidaXL came for organic (international seo link building); Partnertele for organic (seo italy); Easybrain (Solitaire) for organic (link building for online games); VoucherCodes.ae for organic and web (seo recovery for a coupon website); BusTravel Iceland for organic and AI (seo and aiso in the tourism industry); Kiwi.com for AI and organic (ai authority link building); Giacomo Conti for AI and organic (ai search optimization for menswear); Culligan Water for AI (aiso); Sortmund for organic, commerce and AI (seo and aiso for a military ecommerce store); Dream Design for organic and local (local seo); Home Concept Galleries for paid (foot traffic from google and pinterest ads); Selling Sunset Estate for brand (brand awareness for a real estate agency).

Names only: Iguana Store, Knieja, Jobman, Daniken, Vikk Meble, Clinic Form Grupa Lekarska, SIP-Krosno, LongLife, ATK Store and Insgraf, where the need is inferred from what it leads with, which is SEO; the record lists no shared clients.

What the base needs next: the Horus read ties it to KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation), KJ2 (ads inside AI answers) and KJ6 (the agency middle is being hollowed out). It is likely, moderate confidence, that the organic heavy book next buys AI visibility measurement and paid tests inside assistants, where its AISO cases and ChatGPT Ads move already point.
house: Say and do: 3 of 4 tested lines are practised on its own house. AI Search / GEO is corroborated: it publishes llms.txt and its sitemap holds 152 AI topic URLs. LinkedIn advertising is corroborated: it runs its own LinkedIn ads (23+). Paid Social is contradicted: it sells paid social and runs no social ad pixel on its own site. Paid Search is unknown: the Transparency Center lookup was blocked. The sitemap lists 4556 URLs with 4 updated in 90 days and 5 in 365 days, which the cadence test reads as corroborated. No AI crawlers are blocked. Tag stack gtm only; CMS WordPress; no pixels, test tools or ABM stack. LinkedIn: active, 23 company page ads and 0 thought leader ads; 169 ads match the name query and more pages exist, so 23 is a floor; the samples are Polish, including 'Masz sklep na Magento? Sprawdź, jak podnieśliśmy sprzedaż u naszego klienta!' Meta and TikTok: no record.
market:
The Horus read gives a tailwind index of 7.4, band Neutral, verdict Neutral (+7). Best placed for KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation, net 0.35), driven by AI Search / GEO (+2) and Paid Search (+1) against SEO (-1), and KJ2 (net 0.263). Most exposed to KJ6 (the agency middle is being hollowed out, net -0.304), driven by Paid Search, SEO and Paid Social at -1 each, and KJ4 (the platforms are absorbing the execution layer, net -0.219). Best scenario fit: The Walled Oasis (42/100). Moves: making P1 (an audited AI visibility product), partial on P2, P4 and P8, absent on P3, P6 and P7, unknown on P5.

The Monsoon read gives index 57.1, band Onshore wind, observed. Displacement 60.1 runs above migration 54.1: the book buys on price more than the hours move, and the destination term scores -15 with Kraków the listed hub office. SEO (14) and Paid Search (9) carry the most movable hours; the shore split is 65% South and Southeast Asia and 26% Eastern Europe. No onshore claims are listed.
openings: It is very likely (high confidence) that the paid social contradiction is the one to lead with: it sells Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn and Pinterest Ads and cites a 115% revenue lift, yet runs no social ad pixel on its own site; a rival that shows its own pixel stack and first party data inputs (P4) makes the point in one screenshot. The falsifier is a social pixel appearing on delante.co at the next compile. It is likely (moderate confidence) that the SEO heavy book is price contestable: displacement 60.1, a mixed icp and 9 of 12 observed needs on organic demand mean an outcome priced SEO offer meets a base already buying on price, and the record lists no public pricing model beyond a Polish cennik page with figures not captured. It is unlikely that a rival beats it on AI search proof: P1 is making and the Kiwi.com case carries a 25% to 62% share of voice figure. The 10 names only clients, Iguana Store to Insgraf, are the ones to question about described work. It is roughly even chance that the ChatGPT Ads line converts to measured results, since P8 shows no incrementality or holdout capability.
watch: I2, Alphabet Q3 2026 search growth and AI Mode ad disclosures (late October 2026): growth below 10% flags cannibalization of the SEO line it leads with, and above 15% with AI Mode ads live confirms S1 and its KJ1 tailwind.
I10, Reddit US daily users against search referral volatility (late October 2026): US DAUq growth at or below 5% alongside AI Mode growth confirms the UGC starvation risk under KJ1.
I8, holdco Q3 organic growth, headcount and pricing model disclosures (October 2026): output or outcome pricing at a top five holdco would deepen the KJ6 exposure on its SEO and paid search hours.

I3, OpenAI ad run rate disclosures and CPM trend (rolling): the next $2B milestone and its timing, and pricing below $20 CPM, would set the economics of the ChatGPT Ads line it opened in Poland on 24 August 2026.
Follow up the 2026-08 ChatGPT Ads launch for a published case with a holdout, which would move P8 from partial to making.
The next Radar compile after 2026-09-28 refreshes offices, ads, sitemap cadence and clients, and may unblock the Transparency Center read; this dossier is only as fresh as that date.
